env_context_strategy.note: Agent navigates workspace with file tools; memory retrieval injects context; paper uses embedding retrieval over memories.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Multimodal handling (image + PDF/doc flatten/hoisting, text-only model fallback)

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: **🤖 Multi-Agent Team** — 6 sub-agents (plan, research, code, debug, analyze, write) working in concert.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: By default, shell commands (`execute` tool) require human approval before running.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: LangGraph gateway layer: UI-agnostic graph & thread access shared across CLI / TUI / serve / channel

self_verification.evidence_quote: each expansion step uses the feedback to generate refined child ideas
